summary.text: Donny Lambeth is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 75 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as consultant and his county as Forsyth.

paragraphs.text: Lambeth assumed office in the North Carolina House in 2013 and is in his seventh House term, according to the General Assembly's website.
In the 2025-2026 session he is senior chair of the Appropriations Committee, chair of the Health Committee and vice chair of the Appropriations, Health and Human Services Committee.
He is also co-chair of the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Health and Human Services and the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Medicaid.
